event: Tamsin is awake and very still, and says good morning to the ceiling.
Rosa is already frying bread on the black stove and singing, and Nell is up on deck.
Over breakfast Elsie remembers the flower cart notice, and says she must go to the guild.
Nell makes Tamsin promise to come back for supper tonight, before the Marigold goes.

event: Tamsin promises, and Nell makes her say it to Rosa too.
Rosa hugs Elsie at the plank and asks for a slice of the next cake.
Elsie and Tamsin walk back through the city in the mist off the Mere.

pictured.coverAfter: The city was white with mist. It came up off the Mere

event: Tamsin is quiet, and twice bumps Elsie's shoulder on purpose.

event: Elsie says Nell is wonderful; Tamsin says yes, and that she will answer every letter.
The guild hall is just opening, and a sunburnt carter waits by the F-rank board.
She says her escort notice has gone untaken two days, and the reed sprites rob her blind.

memory.fact: From the fifth the F-rank board has: escort a flower cart round the lake villages, five lanterns.

event: Tilly runs in with her braids half done, and stops dead to see them come in together.

pictured.coverAfter: The doors banged. Tilly came in at a run, with her goggles
pictured.outfit: cream blouse with rolled sleeves, too-big scorched apron and belt of corked vials

event: She asks where Elsie was last night; she knocked at the Honeycomb with a pear fizz.
Elsie says she slept on Tamsin's mother's barge, in Tamsin's bunk, and Tilly goes very quiet.

Elsie and Tamsin slept the night of the sixth together in Tamsin's bunk on the Marigold.

Long past the cart's usual dawn start, they set out from the flower market with it.

Elsie tells the growers Tilly is the cleverest person she knows, and Tilly goes pink to the ears.

A finger-long winged thing darts out and steals a rose off the cart.
The carter says reed sprites: harmless, but they take anything bright.

event: Tamsin swats at the next one and misses, and it giggles at her.
Tilly flicks a drop of something sour at the reeds, and the sprites scatter sneezing.
At Larkford they load poppies, and Tilly falls asleep on the cart against Elsie's shoulder.
Elsie keeps very still so as to let her sleep, and tucks a poppy into her braid.
Cora walks beside the cart watching the reeds, and her nose is going pink in the sun.
Elsie wets a broad dock leaf at a trough and lays it on the back of Cora's neck.
Cora stands very still and leaves it there.

changes.note: Bond: Cora 13 → 14 (kindness: a wet dock leaf for her sunburnt neck)

Tamsin says narrow, and grins at Elsie, and Tilly stabs a cherry.

Elsie asks what she's writing; Cora says skills used: none.

event: Past Pennyfield the reeds grow thick right up to the road.
A cloud of sprites boils out of the reeds and mobs the cart, giggling.
One snatches the pink-and-white clip from Elsie's hair and dives into the reeds.

event: Elsie's hand goes to her hair, and her eyes fill.
Tamsin is into the reeds up to her waist before anyone can stop her.

changes.note: Bond: Tamsin 33 → 34 (kindness: into the reeds after Elsie's clip)

event: Cora says reed beds swallow boots, and goes in after her, coat and all.
Elsie and Tilly follow; the mud is warm and comes to their knees.
They find the sprite on a reed head clutching the clip, with three others admiring it.
Elsie crouches in the mud and asks the sprite, politely, for her clip back.
The sprite giggles, shakes its head, and hugs the clip.
Tilly takes two vials from her belt and mixes them into a small, steady blue flame.

changes.note: Tilly gains 10 XP for Brew in the field: the blue flame (20 → 30)

memory.fact: Tilly can mix two vials into a small, steady blue flame that burns without a wick.
Tilly's shaking hands go steady the moment her brew catches.

event: The sprites go silent and stare at the blue flame, enchanted.
Tilly sets the burning vial on a reed root, and the sprite drops the clip to go to it.
Elsie snatches up the clip and kisses Tilly on the cheek, mud and all.

changes.note: Elsie snatches the clip back when the sprite drops it
The clip is in Elsie's hand again

event: Tilly stands in the reeds with her hand on her cheek and forgets to walk.
Tamsin hauls her out by the collar, and Tilly is still holding her cheek.
Elsie pins the clip back in with muddy fingers, and Cora reaches over and straightens it.

changes.note: Elsie pins the clip back in her hair; Cora straightens it

event: Cora's fingers stay a moment at Elsie's temple, and then she steps back.
Back at the cart the carter laughs at the four of them, muddy to the thighs.
At Reedby they load the last buckets: lavender, cornflowers and sweet peas.

pictured.coverAfter: Reedby, at the far end of the round, sat on a spit

event: The growers let them wash at the horse trough, and Tamsin dunks her whole head.
Tamsin shakes her curls like a dog over Tilly, and Tilly shrieks and laughs.
On the road home the cart is so full of flowers the donkey walks in a cloud of scent.
Elsie asks Cora what she likes besides tea; Cora thinks a long while and says quiet.

memory.fact: Besides strong black tea, Cora likes quiet.
Besides strong black tea, Cora likes quiet.
Besides strong black tea, Cora likes quiet.

event: Elsie walks beside her in quiet for a whole field after that, and Cora looks at her twice.
Tilly rides on the cart's tail among the buckets, swinging her muddy boots.
Elsie climbs up beside her; Tilly touches her cheek and asks if Elsie kisses everyone.
Elsie says only people she loves, and kisses the other cheek to make it fair.
Tilly goes so red the carter asks if she's had too much sun.
They come into the city as the lamplighters' boats set out along the canals.
At the flower market the carter unloads into the stalls and pays them the notice.

event: Cora walks them to the guild hall door as it shuts, writes the notice in, and goes off duty.
Elsie gives her a lavender sprig saved from the last bucket; Cora tucks it in her buttonhole.

event: Tamsin says she's due on the Marigold for supper, and asks if Elsie will come.
Elsie says tonight Nell should have Tamsin to herself, and Tamsin should go.

changes.note: Bond: Tamsin 34 → 36 (stand: Elsie gives up supper so Nell has her)

event: Tamsin hugs her hard, and runs for the Long Cut.
Tilly walks Elsie to Thimble Canal, swinging their joined hands.

changes.note: Bond: Tilly 24 → 25 (kindness: hands joined along Thimble Canal)

event: At the Honeycomb door Tilly says goodnight, then says it again, and goes.
In the attic Elsie scrubs the reed mud off her legs at the basin.
She waters the plants and tells Captain the mint about the sprites.
She writes in her notebook: Tilly, blue flame, cheek; Cora, quiet.
Through the Tether she feels Tamsin across the city, loud and warm and laughing.
The baker climbs the narrow stairs with a slice of honey cake on a plate, sets it down, and goes.

changes.note: Bond: Tamsin 36 → 37 (Tether: under it by her own wish at day's end)
